The TSP is often transformed into a **minimum weight perfect matching** on a **complete graph with an even number of nodes**, by duplicating the start/end node (in this case, node 1). This is a known technique to convert TSP into a matching problem.

But since we are limited to the **Hungarian Algorithm** (which is for assignment problems) and the **COPTPY** solver, we will instead proceed with a **direct formulation of the TSP as an Assignment Problem** by using **Miller-Tucker-Zemlin (MTZ) constraints** to avoid subtours.

$$

$$
